text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama-senpai! I heard the schedule for 
the overseas expedition has been decided!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Quick to hear the news, aren't ya, El?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: They were standing straight up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The date for the extended overseas tour 
was steadily drawing near. This time, the 
schedule was set to depart as soon as 
spring ended.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Trainer. Were you 
able to get in touch with Elle-Elle's 
acquaintance?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I was able to say hi through the 
call app.

Yeah, I was able to say hi on the call app 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"During an expedition, you'll be living in 
unfamiliar territory. The more 
acquaintances you have, the better."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Plus, it was El Condor Pasa's 
recommendation. It was a relief to have 
someone reliable and trustworthy waiting 
on-site.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! Well then, Nakayama-senpai, after 
today's training, El-El will give you a 
French lesson!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
First, let's start with an all-purpose 
greeting! "La victoire est à moi!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
……"Don't get cocky." I know a few French 
words too, you know. You can't fool me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ………………Let's rest before that.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Geh?! Cafe-senpai?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...You should relieve your fatigue. If 
you are to journey... to the other side."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... Cafe-senpai and Nakayama-senpai 
became good friends, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, not since the Fan Thanksgiving. Her 
room is actually pretty cozy, you know."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I open my wallet. Tucked inside is the 
travel voucher that had been put on the 
line for the bet.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Still, impressive that you remembered. 
Considering that raffle was nearly a year 
ago.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Which means I've achieved the kind of 
results that allow me to use this."
choice_data_list:
Yeah, you won the bet for the travel 
voucher.

Yeah, you won the bet for the travel 
vouchers.

text_block_list.name: Inn Guest A
text_block_list.text: Huh... Wait, is that Nakayama Festa!?

text_block_list.name: Inn Guest B
text_block_list.text:
It's true! Sh-She must be incognito! We 
have to keep quiet...!

text_block_list.name: Inn Guest B
text_block_list.text:
Since she's carrying the hopes of Japan, 
we've gotta let her relax as much as 
possible in her private life!

text_block_list.name: Inn Guest A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah!! Cheering them on like this is 
pretty much the only thing we can do, 
anyway...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...I can hear everything you're saying, 
though.
choice_data_list:
I'll take you up on your kindness and get 
some rest.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'll stretch my legs while soaking 
in the bath.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the hot water, my shoulders have 
relaxed and my body feels noticeably 
lighter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While turning on the air conditioning, I 
take my laptop out of the bag I brought.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Phew... That was a nice bath...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the AC is on. You're pretty 
thoughtful, aren't you?
choice_data_list:
And you just casually walk into my room 
without asking, huh.

And you just let yourself into my room 
like it's natural, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, what's the harm? And what, are 
you in full-on work mode?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The smartphone chimes with an incoming 
email. The displayed address belonged to 
an acquaintance of El Condor Pasa.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, there were a few replies I wanted to 
send.

Yeah, there are a few replies I want to 
send.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, is it my turn next? After 
Laurel, and Spe..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, there's still more? Pops, 
Jordan... and ...this weirdly named one's 
definitely Golshi.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: These notifications just won't stop.
choice_data_list:
It just means people are expecting that 
much more from you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. El, Cafe too. And even the guest 
we ran into at the inn.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding! Ding!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And the people you're keeping in touch 
with who are out on the overseas 
expedition, too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding! Ding!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding! Ding!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Still, this is way too much! Hey, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We're going outside! Outside! Leave your 
PC and your phone back in your room!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Today's a rest day, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Having people expect things from you is 
nice, but... it also brings a whole lot of 
troublesome baggage.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
First it's "We'd like an interview," then 
it's prospective sponsors showing up left 
and right.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If I were to suddenly vanish right here, 
I'd probably get an earful later.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
True enough. When you're tied down and 
suffocating, running away might be an 
option, too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...... When that time comes, will you run 
away too?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa. The waves are gorgeous. Come on, 
Trainer! Give me your hand!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pulled by the hand by Nakayama Festa, we 
go deeper than the sandy beach. Further 
into the ocean.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Our shoes got soaked, then our knees. 
—And just like that, the two of us tumbled 
into the sea."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Both of you are soaking wet. Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My clothes were soaked. My shoes squelched 
with every step. And my body, which should 
have been washed clean by the hot spring, 
was sticky from the sea breeze.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Because I knew you wouldn't let go of my 
hand.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The person telling me to dream with 
them... if I said I was jumping into the 
ocean to run away, they'd probably just 
jump right into that same ocean after me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Get drenched with me again, alright?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Nakayama Festa...
